current_date: December 2024 (document text: Revised Local Information Requirements (the Local List) 2024, 'issued in December 2024', following consultation 30 Oct - 24 Dec 2023)
current_evidence: Search of lambeth.gov.uk returns only this 2024 revised Local List as the post-consultation version (it replaces the July 2016 list and the October 2023 consultation draft linked from the closed consultation page); no later version was found.

issues.detail: List date 2025-12-01 is taken from the upload folder in the URL (Date basis 'url path (upload month)'). The document itself is the 'Revised Local Information Requirements (the Local List) 2024', issued December 2024, so the list date should be December 2024.
issues.evidence: Document text: consulted on 30 October 2023 - 24 December 2023 and 'issued in December 2024'; page headers read 'Revised Local Information Requirements (the Local List) 2024'.

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none) - national requirements only', but many Lambeth LIRs are triggered by the works rather than the application type and so apply to householder schemes: LIR 1 Site Layout Plan (all applications); LIR 2-5 existing/proposed elevations, floor plans, sections and roof plans (all applications involving building work or roof alterations); LIR 7 CIL Form 1 (all applications); LIR 14 Basement Impact Assessment (any basement development or extension adding floorspace below ground); LIR 52 Methods and Materials Specification (all applications including operational development); LIR 13 Archaeological Assessment (excavation in Archaeological Priority Areas); LIR 25 Dropped Kerb Highways Approval Letter (new vehicular crossover to disabled parking space); LIR 34 Flood Risk Assessment (Flood Zones 2/3); LIR 78 Tree Survey; LIR 22 Daylight/Sunlight (development with potential adverse impact on neighbours).
issues.evidence: LIR 7: applies to 'All applications', householder included; LIR 14: 'All applications for basement development (whether new build...)'; LIR 52: 'all applications that include operational development'. Only LIR 8 (Accessibility Statement) expressly excludes householder.

issues.detail: The source has 84 numbered LIRs; Grokbot captured about 40 as app-type rows. Not captured: LIR 10 Workspace Strategy/Management Plan; 13 Archaeological Assessment (on/near Scheduled Ancient Monument, sites 0.4ha+, ground works in Archaeological Priority Areas); 14 Basement Impact Assessment (all basement development); 17 BREEAM Pre-Assessment (new non-residential majors, conversions over 500 sqm); 18 Build to Rent Statement; 19 Circular Economy Statement (GLA referable applications); 20 Community Use Management Plan; 23 Demolition Method Statement (demolition in conservation areas, of listed/locally listed buildings or in AQMAs, and demolition prior approvals); 25 Dropped Kerb Highways Approval Letter; 30 Evening economy/food and drink management plan; 35 Foul Water and Water Supply Capacity Assessment; 37 Heritage Impact Assessment (World Heritage Sites and settings) and 69 Statement of Heritage Significance; 38 Hostel and HMO Statement; 40 Housing Quality Statement; 42 Industrial Intensification and Co-location Statement; 43 Infrastructure Assessment; 46 Large-scale Purpose-built Shared Living Management Plan; 49 Loss of Existing Housing and Estate Redevelopment Statement; 52 Methods and Materials Specification; 53 Navigational/Riverside Risk Assessment (Port of London Authority area); 55 Parking Design and Management Plan; 62 Public Realm Statement; 64 Safety, Security and Emergency Strategy; 65 Servicing and Delivery Plan; 66-68 Social Infrastructure Impact Assessment / Management Plan / Statement; 71 Student Housing Statement and Management Plan; 76 Transport Assessment/Statement; 79 Urban Greening Factor Assessment; 82 Visitor Accommodation Impact Assessment; 83 Visitor Management Plan; 84 Whole Life Cycle Carbon Assessment. No heritage statement of any kind appears in Grokbot's rows.
issues.evidence: Table of contents of the 2024 Local List, LIRs 1-84.

issues.detail: The tab_items sheet holds only 14 entries and most are not requirements: table-of-contents lines with dot leaders and page numbers (e.g. 'Existing and proposed elevations drawn to metric scale....... 7 3.'), process text ('If you do not supply the information to make the application valid within the timescale given, it may be returned to you'), and guidance-link fragments (Affordable Workspace SPD link, 'Lambeth Design Guide Part 5 Basements (2023) ... link', marketing guidance note link, Refuse & Recycling Design Guide link) filed under 'Submission rules'. A fragment about loss of office/affordable housing fast-track is also filed under 'Submission rules'.
issues.evidence: tab_items rows 0-3 and 8-13 in Grokbot data; source TOC and 'Further guidance on satisfying the requirement' column.

issues.detail: Several trigger excerpts come from the wrong requirement: 'Electric vehicle charging details' quotes the telecoms radio-frequency (ICNIRP) declaration from LIR 26; 'Crime prevention / Secured by Design' quotes student housing management-plan content (LIR 71); 'Ventilation / Extraction details' quotes listed-building floor-plan text about plasterwork; 'Block plan / Site plan' and 'Telecommunications supplementary information' both quote the same telecoms mast site-plan fragment; 'Sunlight to gardens/amenity space' reuses the Playspace/Open Space trigger (LIR 12); 'Viability Assessment' quotes 'no Financial Viability Assessment (FVA) will be required for conventional C3 proposals' (the fast-track exemption) rather than LIR 81's trigger.
issues.evidence: LIR 26 Electronic Communications Code Operators supplementary information; LIR 71 Student Housing Statement; LIR 80 Ventilation or Extraction Statement; LIR 81 Viability Assessments.

issues.detail: Many triggers are cut-off fragments or interleaved table columns that do not state when the requirement applies, e.g. Advertisement drawings 'and their luminance (lux levels).'; Drainage/SuDS 'measures and sustainable drainage measures. 46.'; Planning Statement 'within the Planning Statement(see LIR 58)) 19.'; Waste 'need for a Site Waste Management Plan (SWMP).'; Landscaping 'within the Landscape Strategy (see LIR no. 45)).'; Tall buildings 'guidance on tall buildings contained in Part Page | 66 ...'; Housing mix 'For hotel and other visitor plans showing wheelchair accessible units, including accommodation, this information 10% M4(3) dwellings...'; Roof plan and sections (column text scrambled); Fire Statement merges the high-rise and minor-development triggers. The actual triggers are, for example, LIR 34 FRA 'All development proposals in Flood Zone 2' plus Zones 3a/3b and certain Zone 1 sites; LIR 22 Daylight/Sunlight 'All applications for new residential development and/or where development has potential to cause adverse impacts'.
issues.evidence: Grokbot app_type_rows trigger_excerpt values compared with the 'Application type and/or where local requirement applies' column.

issues.detail: Around 30 requirements are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' even though the list states the trigger. Examples: Lawful development evidence (LIR 31) is under Full planning while 'Lawful development cert' says '(none)'; Telecommunications supplementary information (LIR 26) is under Full planning rather than telecoms prior approval; Lighting Assessment (LIR 47) is under Listed building consent because the text mentions development 'in the vicinity of ... Listed Building' (a location test, not the LBC application type), while its actual triggers are illuminated adverts and external lighting/floodlighting; Demolition Method Statement, which applies to demolition prior approvals, is missing from prior approval. Listed building consent also omits the DAS (LIR 6) and floor plans (LIR 3), which the list says apply to LBC.
issues.evidence: LIR 6 DAS: applies to major development, designated-area schemes and listed building consent; LIR 23: also 'Prior Approval applications for the method of demolition'; LIR 47: 'all illuminated advertisements'.

issues.detail: The 'Planning page' recorded is the '10 common reasons an application is invalid' page, and the council's 'Validation of your application' page does not link to the Local List. The council's consultation page still describes the July 2016 list as 'current', so users may find the out-of-date document. The workbook should note the 2016 list (LAR_Final_22.07.2016.pdf) is superseded.
issues.evidence: Consultation page: 'Lambeth's current list of local information requirements, which was adopted in July 2016' with link to LAR_Final_22.07.2016.pdf.
issues.claude_response: Grok could not verify this, so the finding stands until someone checks it by hand.

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Lambeth Local List (Revised LIR 2024, issued December 2024), but the date comes from the upload path. The extraction is poor: about 40 of 84 LIRs captured, Householder wrongly marked as having no local requirements, the tab sheet is mostly TOC and guidance fragments, and many triggers are garbled or taken from the wrong requirement.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
